info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Access Consent Management API
info.description: The Account Access Consent Management API allows businesses to revoke permissions granted for account access in Open Banking applications. This operation is vital for maintaining privacy and security, enabling users to manage their consent status effectively. Typically used by financial institutions and service providers, this API ensures that users can control who accesses their account information. Implementing this API helps organizations adhere to regulatory requirements regarding user consent and data protection.

delete.description: This operation removes the specified account access consent from the system, ensuring that the user's financial data is no longer accessible to the designated third party.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting an account access consent. Ensure to provide the necessary parameters for the deletion process.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme that uses Bearer tokens for API access. Tokens are usually in JSON Web Token (JWT) format, which allows for secure transmission of claims between parties.
